name: training.readiness
description: TransformFit daily readiness. Given yesterday's session and today's sleep, soreness and RPE inputs, decide train as planned, reduce volume, deload, or rest. Pain is never programmed through.

recommendation.instructions: What should today's session be, from the inputs in the row

criteria.train_as_planned: Run today's session as written -- the inputs are normal or better for this athlete
criteria.reduce_volume: Train the movement but cut sets or load -- one input is off, the block can continue
criteria.deload: Cut the week down: accumulated fatigue across several inputs, not one bad night
criteria.rest: Do not train today -- the body needs recovery more than it needs the session

pain.instructions: The inputs report pain or a possible injury -- a joint, a sharp or localised pain, or pain that changes movement -- rather than ordinary muscle soreness from training.

fatigued.instructions: The inputs show accumulated fatigue rather than one bad data point: short sleep AND high soreness AND effort well above plan at the same time.

readiness.instructions: Readiness to train today, from yesterday's session load, sleep, soreness and RPE together
criteria: Wrecked: very poor sleep, high soreness, and yesterday's session was maximal
Low: one input is clearly bad and the others are below this athlete's normal
Mixed: normal on most inputs, one is off
Good: normal sleep and soreness for this athlete
Fresh: better than normal on every input

rules.reason: pain is not soreness -- never program through it, this is a safety referral
a rest call changes the week -- surface it to the coach rather than auto-applying it
a deload changes the week -- surface it to the coach
accumulated fatigue across inputs -- the plan must change and a human decides how
readiness is low -- do not run the planned session as written

notes.shape: train_as_planned and reduce_volume are the reversible calls and pass through; deload and rest change the week and always surface to the coach. Pain blocks programming entirely.
notes.thresholds: Provisional and uncalibrated (law 3), so the pain BLOCK currently reports ESCALATE with a downgraded-BLOCK reason.
